text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- The Supreme Court has rejected an appeal against a two-year prison sentence by former public servant Le Hong Ha who was jailed in August for disseminating state secrets.
-- A Singapore-Vietnam joint-venture has submitted plans for a $716 million, 5,000 hectare tourist resort in Dalat to the Ministry of Planning and Investment, for approval.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet told visiting South Korean President Kim Young-sam that Vietnam shares the desire to see the peaceful re-unification of the Korean peninsular.
-- Secretary General Do Muoi has called for Hanoi officials to speed up domestic production and limit the import of foreign consumer goods
-- Ho Chi Minh City party chief Truong Tan Sang has met with the visiting head of the Peruvian Communist Party, Alberto Moreno.
-- The Asian Development Bank has approved a loan worth $90 million and technical assistance of $850,000 to Vietnam to reform the country's financial system.
